title: MILimbEEG: Motor and motor-imagery limb EEG dataset (MILimbEEG)
description: MILimbEEG is an EEG dataset of upper- and lower-limb motor execution and motor imagery from 60 volunteers, including healthy participants, amputees, and post-COVID-19 individuals. It contains over 8,680 four-second recordings of hand closing and foot flexion, plus baseline-eyes-open and rest conditions. The recordings were acquired with a 16-channel dry-electrode OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy system at 125 Hz. This BIDS release was generated through MOABB for brain-computer interface research.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 125 Hz with a 16-channel OpenBCI Cyton+Daisy dry-electrode system placed according to the 10-10 montage, with a neutral ear reference. Hardware band-pass filtering (5-50 Hz) and a 60 Hz notch were applied. In each repetition, participants performed and then imagined left/right hand closing and left/right dorsal/plantar foot flexion, with baseline-eyes-open and rest periods, using cue-based visual stimuli.
